title_zh: 约定更正车站历史作业中的日期冲突表述

scenario.label_zh: 约定更正车站历史作业中的日期冲突表述
scenario.goal_zh: 核对两份材料分别记录的事件，并约定把首次客运与开幕仪式分开注明

context_zh: 虚构地方史课堂：学生比较给定日记与报纸节录中的车站日期。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Elliot
sentences.text: There is a contradiction here. The diary says the station opened in 1924, but the newspaper gives 1925.

sentences.speaker: Teacher
sentences.text: Look at what each writer was describing. The diary records a first passenger journey; the newspaper reports the official opening ceremony.

sentences.speaker: Elliot
sentences.text: So I cannot contend that the diary is wrong simply because the dates differ.

sentences.speaker: Teacher
sentences.text: Exactly. What looks like contrary evidence may concern a different event.

sentences.speaker: Elliot
sentences.text: My paragraph calls the diary unreliable. That needs a correction.

sentences.speaker: Elliot
sentences.text: I'll give separate dates for the first passenger service and the official ceremony, with a reference for each.
